title: Golden Gate Assembly Protocol Level 1/2
author: Vinca Seiler
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.8d4hs8w
materials: 0.5 µL BsaI-HF ® v2(NEB) for lvl 1 / EspI3 (NEB) for lvl 2

steps.title: Prepare DNA insert mixture
steps.instruction: Combine 0.5 µL of each DNA insert (or normalize to ~20 fmol each or use 75 ng each; dilute antibiotic‑resistance part 1:10 to 7.5–10 ng) and add nuclease‑free water to a final volume of 10 µL (20 µL may be used).

steps.title: Transform competent cells with assembly
steps.instruction: Add 2–5 µL of the assembled reaction to 50 µL of chemically competent cells.

steps.title: Recover transformed cells
steps.instruction: Incubate the recovered cells for 1 h when selecting with ampicillin, or for 2 min when selecting with kanamycin or chloramphenicol.
